summary: The approved design (0.40.0): sidebar Today, Brands, Calendar, Results and Comments. Today shows what goes out, week stats and what needs Nate; Calendar shows the week with open slots and moves or unschedules posts; Results and Comments come from Ayrshare analytics and comments, with Grok-drafted replies sent through Ayrshare. Brands drop Add an existing account; each brand has tabs Videos, Stories, Schedule, Results and Socials. Settings leads with Ayrshare (profiles, monthly posts, posting times, AI label), Grok and Look. The Inbox page and the sidebar colours menu are gone. Needs you lists Connect Ayrshare and at most one item per brand from Ayrshare's linked state; per-social sign-up and login items stay on the brand's Socials tab.
